name: Dragonhawk
description: An anomaly on Bloomburrow, neither truly from the plane nor an elemental, resembling Kolaghan's dragons with four webbed wings and power over dragonstorms.

description_citations.text: "Dragonhawk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Helga has a vision of Dragonhawk in Pondside around 4564 AR.
timeline.quote: Helga first had a vision of Dragonhawk while in Pondside around 4564 AR .

citation.text: "Dragonhawk", section "Bloomburrow Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zoraline sneezes awake, alerting Dragonhawk to Mabel's party; Ral recognizes it as a dragon.
timeline.quote: Their quiet journey was abruptly disrupted when Zoraline sneezed awake, alerting Dragonhawk to their presence.

citation.text: "Dragonhawk", section "Bloomburrow Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dragonhawk swoops at the party; Ral, with Finneas's arrow, strikes it with lightning.
timeline.quote: Ral called upon his magic to strike the Dragonhawk with a barrage of lightning.

citation.text: "Dragonhawk", section "Bloomburrow Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dragonhawk survives, retreats into the storm clouds, and the animalfolk flee toward the foothills.
timeline.quote: The animalfolk took the opportunity to flee towards the safety of the foothills

citation.text: "Dragonhawk", section "Bloomburrow Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dragonhawk returns to attack in Fountainport but is defeated by Maha and flees.
timeline.quote: was defeated by Maha and fled
